intro: Section A English carries 20 marks in every DSSSB paper. In the 4 official 2023–24 TGT CS papers ({n} questions) about 45% was vocabulary (spelling, idioms and proverbs, one-word substitution, antonyms, homophones, collocations), about 35% was reading — one passage with 5 questions in every paper plus 1–2 para jumbles — and the rest was grammar asked as error spotting or sentence improvement (prepositions, 'No sooner/Hardly' inversion, question tags, conjunctions). The notes are rule tables with right-and-wrong examples, the 100 most-asked words, idioms and spellings, and a step-by-step method for passages and para jumbles.
